title: Violin with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- violin body, warm wood -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#c96a1e'/>
  <rect x='42' y='52' width='16' height='10' rx='3' fill='#c96a1e'/>
  <!-- waist curve shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='20' ry='15' fill='#e08a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='17' ry='12' fill='#b45e18'/>
  <!-- f-holes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='68' rx='2.5' ry='5' fill='#7a3c0c'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='68' rx='2.5' ry='5' fill='#7a3c0c'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='44' y='65' width='12' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <!-- fingerboard and neck -->
  <rect x='46' y='18' width='8' height='34' fill='#3a2a52'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='20' width='5' height='32' fill='#5a4480'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='48' y1='22' x2='46' y2='86' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='0.9'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='50' y2='88' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='0.9'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='22' x2='54' y2='86' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='0.9'/>
  <!-- tailpiece -->
  <rect x='46.5' y='82' width='7' height='12' rx='2' fill='#3a2a52'/>
  <!-- chinrest -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='84' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#6d3d8f'/>
  <!-- scroll -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='6' fill='#3a2a52'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='3' fill='#6d3d8f'/>
  <!-- pegs -->
  <rect x='42' y='24' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <rect x='52' y='28' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <rect x='42' y='32' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <rect x='52' y='36' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <!-- smiling face on the body -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='62' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a52'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='62' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a52'/>
  <path d='M43 71 Q50 78 57 71' stroke='#3a2a52' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='69' r='1.8' fill='#f78fb3'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='69' r='1.8' fill='#f78fb3'/>
</svg>
